_comment: Captured from karmaterminal/frond-alarm submit.sh at commit f78d7944290194502e6ea189779265c25b7dcfad (blob 8e81cf38cafee0e1f005861542bcc841b33c3f96), run with REQUEST_ID set, against a fake gh that records its argv, beside a test princes.json in the alarm's roster format: example-caller is an object (prince, spoken and a placeholder voice_id) and other-caller a bare string, the older format. The fake issue number is 42. test_summon.py checks that summon.py writes the same title, label, body and wake for the same inputs.

vectors.name: default line, manual, live
args: Need paws on the build host: it is off the network and will not come back by itself.
vectors.title: [call] summon-golden-0001
vectors.body:
<!-- frond-call-v1 -->
```json
{"dry_run": false, "from": "example", "line": "707", "request_id": "summon-golden-0001", "source": "prince_manual", "text": "Need paws on the build host: it is off the network and will not come back by itself."}
```
